answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require earned reputation before payment: a new identity starts at zero and must complete verifiable tasks graded by independent peers, with earnings held in umber escrow until a history of good work accumulates. An attacker cannot simply wander in with a thousand fresh identities, because each one must separately do real, graded work to gain trust. The cost scales with the number of fakes, while an honest agent reuses one history across many jobs, making a tundra of empty identities expensive to cross and worthless without proof.
